_readme: S527 SkyLoganberry, 2026-10-30. The courses Glendale's live records place without units lead with the state's C-numbers (STAT C1000 on 15 records, PSYC C1000 on 11, COMM C1000, POLS C1000, ENGL C1000) and the old numbers the entry renumbers to them (ENGL 101, ENGL 104, POL S 101). kb/_description_units.py read each description's number as C?\d{1,3}, so a four-digit C-number never matched and none of these is in the units file. This read prints the description pages (128-301) whose header carries a four-digit C-number, so the parser can be fixed against the catalog's own words. One load of the 2025-2026 PDF, no model call. The first push (run 41047695384) matched no page: the ' · ' in a log is the reader folding short lines, so the keyword now matches a C-number standing alone on its line. Third push: the C-number descriptions print no code in their body, so the runner now prints the parser's unkeyed C-numbers (parse_units).

questions.course_units: Each course description numbered C followed by four digits: its number, title, units and the code its body names.
